shared_elements: procession of bearded male figures in profile walking in single file
tribute/gift bearers holding vessels or objects
led animal(s) accompanying the human procession
rosette band border along the base of the relief
low-relief frieze with figures on a common ground line
figures in belted tunics with patterned hair/headdress
hand of a lead figure touching or leading an animal
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: a single-file procession of bearded men in profile, in belted tunics with stippled coiffures, carrying vessels and leading a large horned/humped animal, all set on a ground line above (and below) a continuous band of rosettes. The only differences are the specific animal led (rams versus a camel) and the number of visible bearers, which is well within variation of one iconographic tradition.
